attributes.additional_details: The labour prime minister has resigned. A new prime minister should be voted in by the people after hearing a clear mandate and proposal for the country.
attributes.background: Call for a General Election. Allow the people to express their wishes for a new Prime Minister and Party.

rejection.details:
You may wish to sign this petition:

General election now – and always call one if a PM is replaced
